title: Check numeric group coercion in two consecutive Semver4j releases
description: Quantify a bounded grammar of decimal groups with missing groups, leading zeros and unchanged controls, compiling the same caller before the change.
expected: Preserve each registered input, record literal verdicts and costs, and keep incomplete or scope-mismatched results in the denominator.

steps.name: python3 -B lib/benchmark/beyond-jbmc/freeze_product.py run -
steps.run: python3 -B lib/benchmark/beyond-jbmc/freeze_product.py run -- python3 -B lib/benchmark/beyond-jbmc/release_cases.py qualified C08-5.6.0 C08-5.7.0
